description: Tell a named movement leader's actual story of informational and relational fragmentation. Inventories every place their content currently lives — books, PDFs, articles, blogs, websites, social media, their own head, notes/laptop, apps, podcasts, YouTube, sermons, talks — with specific titles and locations pulled from prior research. Use when asked to map fragmentation for a leader, audit where their content is scattered, or produce a "where does it all live" report. Reads from `docs/movement_leader_research/{slug}/` and writes `fragmentation-story.md` into that leader's folder.
